prompt:
Create a HIGH RESOLUTION original production texture atlas for a modular ancient Chinese city-builder. Landscape 3:2 canvas at highest resolution, ideally 1536x1024 or larger. EXACT regular grid of 3 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS, SIX equal SQUARE flat material textures, all the way to their cell edges. No margins, no gaps, no captions, no labels, no frame outlines. Each cell is an orthographic flat frontal surface, ZERO perspective, ZERO dimensional extrusion, NO building silhouettes. Even neutral diffuse illumination, no directional cast shadows, no baked ambient occlusion, no bloom, no depth of field. Crisp high-frequency hand-painted realistic surface detail, clean readable microtexture, warm restrained historic palette.
Top row left to right: 1 traditional Chinese dark slate grey overlapping cylindrical roof tiles, straight parallel vertical channels and horizontal tile courses, perfectly flat top-down surface texture; 2 warm ivory lime plaster wall with subtle aged fine grain, no holes, no plants; 3 weathered dark cool grey rectangular masonry bricks in staggered rows with thin pale mortar.
Bottom row left to right: 4 pale grey granite foundation block masonry, large horizontal rectangular stones and subtle chiseling; 5 warm brown straight vertical wooden planks, fine grain, small dark nails, closely fitted with thin seams; 6 faded muted ochre woven canvas cloth, subtle fine textile weave, nearly plain uninterrupted fabric.
All six are repeatable MATERIAL surfaces used on programmatic 3D wall/roof planes. They are not architectural drawings or buildings. Each texture consistent detail density and exact square boundaries. No background behind grid because the six materials fill the entire canvas.

Create a HIGH RESOLUTION production sprite atlas of MODULAR ARCHITECTURAL PARTS for an original traditional Chinese city building game. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, truly clean alpha outside each part, absolutely no shadows, glow, halo, checkerboard, background color, labels, text, borders, people, assembled buildings or landscape. Exactly TWELVE isolated individual structural components in a strict regular 4 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS grid, wide transparent separation, each fits entirely in its cell and is centered. Highest available resolution, ideally at least 1536x1024. ALL components are straight-on ORTHOGRAPHIC FRONT ELEVATION, ZERO perspective and no side faces, no camera tilt. Crisp clean silhouettes and sharp hand-painted realistic wood/stone detail, muted slate-grey roof elements, deep cinnabar red paint, warm natural timber, ivory stone. Consistent physical scale/detail density.
Row1 left to right: 1 one straight vertical red lacquer wooden column with small stone foot and simple capital; 2 one straight vertical natural timber column with small stone foot; 3 one single long HORIZONTAL red lacquer squared timber beam; 4 one single long HORIZONTAL natural oak squared timber beam.
Row2 left to right: 5 one symmetrical traditional wooden dougong bracket cluster, front view, red timber and understated ochre ends; 6 one long horizontal dark grey ceramic roof ridge-cap strip with repeating cap segments, front elevation; 7 one single rectangular dark-wood lattice window, ivory translucent paper behind geometric wooden lattice; 8 one ornate rectangular closed red double wooden door with brass circular ring handles, includes its simple wooden frame.
Row3 left to right: 9 one plain closed rustic natural-wood double plank door with visible hinges and its wooden frame; 10 one round brick kiln firebox mouth, front elevation, arched red fired clay surround, dark hollow interior and small warm embers only inside the opening; 11 one curved upturned dark grey tiled eave-corner trim piece, front elevation, NOT a whole roof; 12 one short straight horizontal wooden railing segment with three vertical balusters.
These are construction kit fragments for code to assemble and project, never complete miniature buildings. No floor tiles or platforms. All images whole and separated with generous transparent padding.

Create an original high resolution 2D skeletal animation CUTOUT PARTS atlas for a historical Chinese city-building game. Transparent background, clean alpha, no cast shadows, no glow, no halos, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Exactly TWELVE separated components in a strict regular 4 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS grid, complete isolated parts with generous transparent gutters. Largest resolution. Orthographic front-facing game cutouts, mildly three-quarter human front view but zero perspective distortion, consistent single scale between body parts. Realistic hand-painted miniature illustration, crisp edges, warm tan skin, indigo cotton workwear, brown cloth belt, simple brown footwear. Neutral soft lighting. The body pieces must form ONE COHERENT adult ancient Chinese worker when assembled, anatomically natural proportions. Do not draw any complete person; do not connect body parts.
Row1 left to right: 1 single adult worker HEAD with short dark hair and neutral face plus small neck, NO HAT, no torso; 2 single sleeveless TORSO wearing indigo work tunic with brown belt and hips, neck opening at top, no head, NO arms, NO legs; 3 single upper ARM segment with indigo short sleeve and tan skin ending just above elbow, vertical neutral pose, rounded shoulder top; 4 single FOREARM segment with tan skin and closed relaxed hand at bottom, vertical pose, rounded elbow top.
Row2 left to right: 5 single THIGH segment in indigo cotton trousers, vertical neutral pose, hip top/knee bottom; 6 single LOWER LEG shin segment in indigo trousers ending at ankle, vertical neutral pose, knee top/ankle bottom; 7 single simple brown SHOE foot cutout, ankle top and toe pointing right; 8 single wooden-handled building HAMMER with grey iron head, handle vertical.
Row3 left to right: 9 single wooden long-handled farming HOE with small angled iron blade, handle diagonal; 10 single long slender horizontal bamboo CARRYING POLE, gently curved; 11 single round woven wicker CARRYING BASKET with loop handle; 12 single broad woven straw CONICAL HAT, front three-quarter view with underside dark.
Visible flexible joint overlaps on the separated body segments suitable for code to rotate around shoulders, elbows, hips, knees and ankles. Arms and legs will be mirrored to make left/right copies. These are individual rig pieces, never a sheet of whole characters.
